LESSON: SELF- EXPRESSION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1.1: Self- expression

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Self- expression
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how one can best use their leisure time. 1. How do you spend your leisure time?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe leisure activities for information
2. appreciate listening to texts in varied contexts

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe leisure activities for information

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe leisure activities for information.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “describe leisure activities for information” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate listening to texts in varied contexts

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate listening to texts in varied contexts.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate listening to texts in varied contexts” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate listening to texts in varied contexts” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe leisure activities for information
• Model 2: appreciate listening to texts in varied contexts

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe leisure activities for information
2. Practise: appreciate listening to texts in varied contexts

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Self- expression.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how one can best use their leisure time. 1. How do you spend your leisure time?
2. Why should we express our opinions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe leisure activities for information
• appreciate listening to texts in varied contexts
